NDCI.name: NDCI
limitations: Proxy for chlorophyll-a absorption contrast, NOT mg/m3
Designed for turbid productive water; weak in clear oligotrophic water
Raised by bright bottom and by sediment red-edge scattering
Becomes a concentration only after local in-situ calibration

MCI.name: MCI
MCI.reference: Gower et al. (2005) Int. J. Remote Sens. 26(9):2005-2012 (MERIS); S2 band adaptation as in Toming et al. (2016) Remote Sens. 8(8):640
limitations: Peak height above a red-to-NIR baseline; responds to high-biomass blooms and floating vegetation
S2 B05 (20 m, ~15 nm wide) is broader than MERIS 709 nm, so absolute values are not comparable with MERIS/OLCI MCI
Negative in clear water; sediment-rich water can also raise it

FAI.name: FAI
limitations: Detects material AT the surface (floating algae, scum, sargassum, some surface films); subsurface blooms may not register
Positive values also come from whitecaps and land adjacency

RE_RATIO.name: RE_RATIO
RE_RATIO.reference: Gitelson et al. (2008) Remote Sens. Environ. 112:3582-3593 (two-band red-edge model)
limitations: Proxy until locally calibrated
Unstable when B04 approaches the noise floor

CDOM_RATIO.name: CDOM_RATIO
CDOM_RATIO.reference: Kutser et al. (2005) Remote Sens. Environ. 94:535-540 (green/red ratio for CDOM); used with S2 in Toming et al. (2016)
limitations: Confounded by chlorophyll and sediment; a relative indicator only
Calibrations are water-body specific

TUR_NECHAD2016.name: TUR_NECHAD2016
TUR_NECHAD2016.formula: A * rho_w / (1 - rho_w / C), rho_w at B04
TUR_NECHAD2016.reference: Nechad, Ruddick & Park (2009) Remote Sens. Environ. 113:2141-2154; S2 MSI coefficients: Nechad 2016 calibration
limitations: Coefficients calibrated on North Sea / Scheldt data, NOT on UAE waters
Saturates in very turbid water (use the NIR branch / Dogliotti)
Bright shallow bottom is read as turbidity
Requires water-leaving reflectance; L2A surface reflectance is an approximation even after the SWIR offset

SPM_NECHAD2016.name: SPM_NECHAD2016
SPM_NECHAD2016.formula: A * rho_w / (1 - rho_w / C), rho_w at B04
SPM_NECHAD2016.reference: Nechad, Ruddick & Park (2010) Remote Sens. Environ. 114:854-866; S2 MSI coefficients: Nechad 2016 calibration
limitations: Coefficients calibrated outside the UAE; mass-specific scattering of Gulf carbonate sediment differs from North Sea mineral sediment
Not a laboratory TSS value

TUR_DOGLIOTTI2015.name: TUR_DOGLIOTTI2015
TUR_DOGLIOTTI2015.formula: T_red if rho_w(B04)<0.05; T_nir if >0.07; linear blend between; T = A rho_w / (1 - rho_w / C)
TUR_DOGLIOTTI2015.reference: Dogliotti et al. (2015) Remote Sens. Environ. 156:157-168
limitations: Published coefficients are for 645/859 nm and are applied to the closest S2 bands (665/865 nm), exactly as ACOLITE does
Not validated in UAE waters
Bright bottom is read as turbidity

HUE_ANGLE.name: HUE_ANGLE
HUE_ANGLE.formula: alpha = atan2(y - 1/3, x - 1/3) from CIE chromaticity of B01-B05, plus a 5th-order sensor correction polynomial
HUE_ANGLE.reference: Van der Woerd & Wernand (2018) Remote Sens. 10(2):180; Wernand et al. (2013) PLoS ONE 8(6):e63766
limitations: A colour, not a constituent. The angle DECREASES from blue to brown: clear blue water ~200-230 deg, green ~90-120 deg, brown ~20-60 deg
B01 is 60 m, so the angle is effectively a 60 m product
